product_overview: Juragan Grosir is an online storefront for retail and wholesale eyewear: customers can browse products, choose variants, add to a local cart, and complete checkout with real-time shipping rates. Registered users can manage their account and apply to become resellers.
core_goals: Discover and browse the full eyewear catalog with filters and sorting
View product details, choose variants, and understand tier / reseller pricing
Assemble and manage a cart with live subtotal and tier pricing applied
Complete checkout with address autocomplete and real-time shipping selection
Create and sign in to a customer account and apply to become a reseller
Contact the store via a contact form or quick WhatsApp access

features.name: Product Browsing
features.description: Browse the product catalog, apply filters and sorting, view product details and variants, and inspect pricing tiers.
user_flows: Navigate to /shop -> View product grid on shop page -> Apply category filter: Eyeglasses -> Apply color filter: Black -> Select a product card to view details -> View product specifications, pricing tiers, and variant options -> Select product variant (color/type/size)
Navigate to /shop -> Apply filters that exclude all products -> See no-products-found message

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Add products from product pages to a local cart, adjust quantities, remove items, and see a live subtotal that respects tier pricing.
user_flows: Navigate to /shop -> Select a product card to view details -> Select product variant (color/type/size) -> Add product to cart from product page -> Navigate to /cart -> View cart items with quantities and prices -> Increase item quantity -> See subtotal update in real-time -> Decrease item quantity -> See subtotal update in real-time
Navigate to /shop -> Add product to cart from product page -> Navigate to /cart -> Remove item from cart -> See cart update and subtotal recalculated

features.name: Checkout with Biteship Shipping
features.description: Enter customer and address details, use area autocomplete to populate province/city/postal code, get real-time courier rates from Biteship, select courier and payment method, and submit the order.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Fill customer name, phone, and email -> Type city/district name in autocomplete field -> Select area from dropdown results -> See province, city, and postal code auto-filled -> Fill detailed address -> View available shipping rates (JNE, J&T, Central Cargo) -> Select shipping courier and service -> Select payment method (QRIS, VA, Transfer) -> Review order summary with shipping cost -> Submit order
Navigate to /checkout -> Leave a required field blank (e.g., detailed address) -> See validation error prompting to fill the field

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Sign in or register with an email/password account to access the account dashboard and reseller application flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email and password on login page -> Submit login form -> See account dashboard at /account
Navigate to /register -> Fill registration form (name, email, phone, password) -> Submit registration form -> See account dashboard at /account

features.name: Reseller Application (Account)
features.description: Authenticated customers can submit an application to become a reseller and track application status from their account.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email and password on login page -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /account -> Navigate to /account/become-reseller -> Fill reseller application form -> Submit application -> See confirmation that application is pending review

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Send messages to the store via a contact form and receive an on-screen confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill name, email, subject, and message fields -> Submit contact form -> See success confirmation

features.name: Navigation and Layout
features.description: Use site-wide header, footer, mobile menu, cart shortcut, and floating WhatsApp access to navigate and contact the store.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Use header navigation to go to /shop -> See product grid on shop page
Navigate to / -> Click cart icon to go to /cart -> See cart page
Navigate to / -> Use mobile hamburger menu -> Select a navigation link to go to /collections -> See collections page
Navigate to / -> Click floating WhatsApp button -> See WhatsApp contact initiated

known_limitations.issue: Cart is stored in localStorage, not synced across devices
known_limitations.impact: Cart contents lost when clearing browser data or switching devices

known_limitations.issue: Payment processing is not yet integrated (no Midtrans/Xendit)
known_limitations.impact: Orders are created with pending status but no actual payment flow
